placements.quote: Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS) in the Abruzzo region of central Italy

summary.plain: About 1500 crystals of lithium molybdate, designed to both flash light and register heat when a particle hits them, planned to fill CUORE's existing refrigerator under the Gran Sasso mountain.
summary.technical: Planned array of ~1500 Li2MoO4 scintillating bolometers targeting 100Mo (Qbb = 3034 keV), to be installed in the existing CUORE cryostat at LNGS.

technology.quote: Lithium molybdate crystals, described as a scintillating material with a particle-dependent light yield
